crossRefs.note: Then she said, “Please let the king remember Yahweh your God, that the avenger of blood destroy not any more, lest they…
For, as Yahweh lives, who saves Israel, though it is in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die.” But there was not a man…
The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths, and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: The king said to Joab, “Behold now, I have done this thing. Go therefore, and bring the young man Absalom back.”
translations.bsb: Then the king said to Joab, “I hereby grant this request. Go, bring back the young man Absalom.”
translations.kjv: And the king said unto Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing: go therefore, bring ➔ the young man Absalom again.
translations.asv: And the king said unto Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing: go therefore, bring the young man Absalom back.
